headline: Appraisal wells completed for Teesside CCS (Endurance store)
summary: Trade press reported completion of the carbon-storage appraisal wells for the Teesside CCS programme, advancing characterisation of the Endurance saline-aquifer store that will anchor the Northern Endurance Partnership / Net Zero Teesside hub.
co2crc_note: Storage appraisal/characterisation progress at a flagship UK T&S hub — directly relevant to CO2CRC's storage-site and MMV expertise.

extractor_note: £200m is project build cost (project-capex), not a funding award; capacity approximate (~0.24-0.25 Mtpa).
headline: £200m Deeside (Parc Adfer) carbon capture plant recommended for approval
summary: Enfinium's proposed ~£200m post-combustion carbon-capture retrofit at the Parc Adfer energy-from-waste facility on Deeside was recommended for approval following further community consultation; the scheme would capture close to a quarter of a million tonnes of CO2 a year.
co2crc_note: EfW capture siting/consultation case — community-engagement and social-licence lessons for Australian projects.

extractor_note: pilot-scale trial (phase-one ~300 kg CO2/day); capacity not materially quantified.
headline: ArcelorMittal, MHI and BHP complete carbon capture trial at Gent steel plant
summary: ArcelorMittal, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and BHP reported completing their pilot carbon-capture trial on blast-furnace off-gas at ArcelorMittal's Gent steelworks in Belgium, a step in assessing post-combustion capture for hard-to-abate steel production.
co2crc_note: Steel-sector post-combustion capture pilot (MHI solvent) — technology watch for capture on hard-to-abate industry.

extractor_note: turnkey EPC award; no cost figure stated; start-up ~end of decade.
headline: Linde Engineering to build turnkey carbon capture plant for 200,000 t/yr EfW facility
summary: Linde Engineering was awarded a turnkey contract to build a ~200,000 t/yr carbon-capture plant at the Filbornaverket energy-from-waste facility in Helsingborg, Sweden, pairing BASF's OASE blue solvent with Linde's CO2 purification and liquefaction; start-up is targeted around the end of the decade.
co2crc_note: EfW capture EPC (BASF OASE blue + Linde) — supply-chain and technology benchmark for post-combustion capture.

extractor_note: $25-30m is expected annual earnings (economic contribution), not a new money commitment -> amount null.
headline: LSB Industries targets $25-30m annual CCS earnings from El Dorado project
summary: On its Q3 2026 results, LSB Industries reiterated it expects roughly $25-30m in annual earnings once its El Dorado, Arkansas carbon-capture-and-sequestration project is fully operational, underpinned by the 45Q tax credit (currently $85/t); the project is designed to capture ~400,000-500,000 t/yr of CO2.
co2crc_note: Illustrates the US 45Q-driven ($85/t) business case for CCS on blue-ammonia production.

headline: How a U.N. report legitimized carbon capture and skewed decades of climate policy
summary: A ProPublica investigation argues that an influential UN/IPCC assessment helped legitimise carbon capture and shaped decades of climate policy, questioning the technology's scientific and policy foundations — a high-profile, sector-wide reputational critique.
co2crc_note: Major investigative critique of CCS's scientific legitimacy — a significant social-licence/reputational signal the whole sector (and CO2CRC) must be able to answer.

headline: Opinion: Europe's CCS market is maturing — what's working?
summary: A Carbon Herald opinion piece makes the constructive case that Europe's CCS market is maturing, highlighting the policy and project elements that are working — a counterpoint to the week's sceptical coverage.
co2crc_note: Constructive framing of European CCS progress — useful for CO2CRC stakeholder communications.

headline: Community pushback and regulatory uncertainty giving pause to CCS players
summary: A US trade analysis reports that community opposition and regulatory uncertainty are causing CCS developers to pause or slow projects, underscoring the permitting and social-licence headwinds facing the sector.
co2crc_note: Permitting and community-opposition headwinds slowing US CCS — community-engagement lessons for Australian storage projects.
